div.div:
Choreography Trade-Offs:
• Decentralized: No single coordinator or bottleneck.
• Extensibility: Dynamic itinerary determined at runtime.
• Failure Liability: If Inventory fails, Billing doesn't know it must refund unless reverse compensation slips are embedded.

div.div:
Orchestration Trade-Offs:
• Deterministic Recovery: Coordinator manages rollback matrix and state history.
• Decoupled Services: Workers know only their own task API, not the workflow sequence.
• Coordination Overhead: Coordinator requires database state storage and crash recovery.

div.div: Architectural Rule of Thumb: Use Routing Slip for linear, forward-only data transformations with zero backward dependencies. Use Process Manager (Saga) whenever transactions require multi-entity coordination, timeouts, or semantic compensating rollbacks.
